::: {#rem-question-partition-events}
#### A question partitions the sample space

The [events](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) $\{X \in C\}$,
one for each [possible answer](#def-possible-answer) $C$ to a [question](#def-question) about $X$,
are [disjoint](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-mutually-exclusive),
and together they hold every [outcome](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-experiment-outcome) at which $X$ takes a value in $\srcalph$,
an event of [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1$.
So, apart from an event of probability $0$, they form a
[partition of the sample space](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-partition).

:::
